definitions.explanation: Relating to the foundation or basics of something. Used to describe knowledge, skills, research, or conditions that form the essential groundwork.

examples.japanese: {基礎的|きそてき}な⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧。
⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{基礎的|きそてき}な⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}びましょう→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: Let's first learn the basic grammar.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{基礎的|きそてき}な⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: This university puts effort into fundamental research.

notes: Common collocations: {基礎的|きそてき}な⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧ (fundamental knowledge), {基礎的|きそてき}な⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧ (basic/fundamental research), {基礎的|きそてき}な⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧ (basic physical fitness), {基礎的|きそてき}な⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (basic ability). Compare with ⟦{基本的|きほんてき}→基本的：04787_kihonteki⟧ (basic — more commonly used in everyday speech) and ⟦{根本的|こんぽんてき}→根本的：17920_konponteki⟧ (fundamental — implies getting to the root cause). {基礎的|きそてき} is often used in academic and formal contexts.
